supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-ledger failures occurred on FILE-SUN-01 at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:34 through 13:49 UTC. The events report invalid-password status 0xc000006a and identify FILE-SUN-01 as the workstation.
Domain-controller records corroborate failed authentication for svc-ledger from FILE-SUN-01, including bad-password status in 4776 events and pre-authentication failure status 0x18 in 4771 events.

The failure cadence and source host are consistent with the supplied context that LedgerSync runs on FILE-SUN-01 and re-authenticates every minute, with a svc-ledger password rotation scheduled shortly before the failures began. This supports a stale job credential as the likely explanation, rather than establishing malicious activity.

At 13:48 UTC, WS-IDOYLE-01 recorded an explicit-credentials event targeting svc-ledger on FILE-SUN-01. The host is the designated remote-administration workstation, and the event is temporally consistent with an attempt to update the job credentials; the record alone does not prove who initiated it or what action followed.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:25 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage; this limits network corroboration but does not alter the observed authentication failure pattern.
The supplied authentication records stop at 13:49 UTC, so they do not show the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC review window.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish that the scheduled password rotation was completed or that LedgerSync was successfully updated afterward.
The explicit-credentials event does not establish which person initiated it, whether it was the planned credential update, or whether that update succeeded.
The supplied records do not establish whether svc-ledger authenticated successfully later in the review window.
